card.name: Words just before a named drug
card.fires_on: Dosage-form words (tablet, tablets) after a number, the word 'to' or 'of' right before a drug name, and the ending of long words like INTERACTIONS and INFECTIONS in all-caps warnings.

modes.label: Dose form before a drug
modes.description: A tablet word, or 'to' or 'of', that comes right before the drug name.
modes.example: patients exposed<< to>> glatiramer acetate injection

modes.label: Capitalized warning words
modes.description: The ending of INTERACTIONS or INFECTIONS in all-caps boxed warning lists.
modes.example: MEDICATION ERRORS; INTERA<<CTIONS>> WITH DRUGS AFFECTING CY

modes.label: Tablet after dose
modes.description: The word tablet(s) after a mg amount or count in dosing lines.
modes.example: mg<< tablets>> once daily or two 200
